facts.fact: The BCEAO's Instruction of 23 January 2024 on payment services distinguishes payment institutions from banks, microfinance institutions and e-money institutions, and the article reports licences issued under it in Benin.
facts.system: Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: Four companies (Julaya Bénin, Open SI, FedaPay Bénin, QOS Integrated Center Bénin) held payment institution licences in Benin at 31 August 2026, per the BCEAO list; licences dated Sept 2025 to July 2026.
facts.system: Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
